title: Crispy Crust Baking
short: Plan sourdough bakes, track starter feeds and save your bread photos and notes.
description:
Bring your next loaf to life. Crispy Crust Baking helps you plan a sourdough bake, care for your starter and keep the photos and notes that make your next bake better.

From a first white sourdough to rosemary bread, olive focaccia and something sweet, find a recipe you want to make and see what comes next. Keep your baking day, starter jars and finished loaves together in one kitchen companion.

PLAN A BAKE AROUND YOUR DAY

Start now or schedule a future bake. Choose your starter, set your kitchen temperature and add the times you will be away from the kitchen. Review the timeline before you begin, including hands-on steps, waiting periods and supported fridge rests.

See the estimated time from start to finish alongside the time you will actually spend working with the dough. Add ingredients to your shopping list when you plan, with recorded pantry stock taken into account.

FOLLOW ONE STEP AT A TIME

Open Bake Mode for a full-screen view of the current step. Swipe between stages to check what is coming, then mark a task complete to move forward and start the next waiting timer when needed.

Separate instructions and dough cues help you understand both what to do and what to look for. Keep an eye on your progress, time remaining and step count. Take photos along the way and keep several images with the same bake.

CARE FOR EVERY STARTER JAR

Give each starter a name, choose a jar mascot or use your own photo, and keep its storage location and feeding history close at hand.

See how long it has been since the last feed and when the next feed is due. Check starter age, hydration, starter weight and jar weight. Log a feed by entering how much starter you retain or remove, and let the app calculate the other amount.

Choose which starter you use for a bake, keep a record of its use and build a photo history of your jar over time.

FIND YOUR NEXT FAVOURITE RECIPE

Browse bread, focaccia, pizza, sweet bakes and discard ideas. Explore 30 recipes, including rosemary sourdough, olive bread, sun-dried tomato bread and focaccia with herbs and savoury toppings.

Check the overview, ingredients and step-by-step method in separate swipeable tabs. Review skill level, overall time and hands-on time before choosing a recipe for your day.

KEEP USEFUL TOOLS NEARBY

• Feeding calculator for starter, flour and water amounts.
• Hydration calculator to check a dough or work towards a target.
• Temperature-based rise estimates to help with planning.
• Quick timers for familiar tasks such as stretch and folds.
• Pantry and shopping records connected to bake planning.
• Guides for starter care and baking techniques.

BUILD A JOURNAL WORTH COMING BACK TO

Save the finished loaf alongside the process that produced it. Add notes and multiple photos, including images from your camera or gallery. Record a bake manually or keep the result of a guided bake, then return to your journal when you want to make it again.

START WITH YOUR OWN KITCHEN

Use starter tracking, bake planning and your journal locally. Sign in when you want to connect available online services. Optional Crispy Crust Pro subscriptions are available monthly and annually, with the price and purchase terms shown before you confirm.

Fermentation depends on your starter, dough and kitchen conditions. Timings and rise forecasts are estimates. Use the recipe's visual and tactile cues alongside the schedule.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Google Play account. Manage or cancel your subscription in Google Play subscription settings.
